messages:
Maya Patel: Quick follow-up from last night's incident — auth provider throttled refreshes which cascaded into model-registry 502s and cloud LB flapping. Need clear owners for mitigation items.
Ravi Menon: Summary: many short-lived tokens -> simultaneous refreshes -> vendor 429s -> our retries amplified load -> registry 502s -> LB churn.
Elena Garcia: Timeline I captured: 23:42 UTC spike, 23:45 vendor 429 surge, 23:50 registry errors, 00:05 LB unstable, autoscaling stabilized around 00:27.
Tom Wu: Immediate hotfix: raise token cache TTL (current=30s) to 240s, add refresh jitter and per-identity dedupe. Config-only, low risk.
Priya Rao: I'll own runbook and alerts. Propose alert: auth.refresh_concurrency > 35 for 5m and composite that with modelregistry.502_rate > 3/min.
Kevin O'Connor: Vendor update: AuthVendor offered a temporary throttle relief for 48h; requested mitigation plan and logs. I'll own vendor liaison + legal loop.
Maya Patel: Owners & timeline proposed:
- Hotfix (24h): Tom (cache + dedupe) + Priya (tests)
- Short (7d): Elena (dashboards + top-refreshers query) + Ravi (vendor SLA ask + logs)
- Long (6-8w): EngRuntime (fallback auth relay/circuit breaker) + Product (token policy)
Tom Wu: Canary config I'll push: 
```
auth_client:
  token_cache_ttl_seconds: 240
  refresh_jitter_ms: 200-900
  per_subject_dedupe_ms: 3000
proxy:
  on_429_backoff: exponential(initial=200ms,max=5s,attempts=5)
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `auth-client-config` (canary=5%). CI green.
Priya Rao: Test plan: staging harness to simulate 400 clients bursting refresh within 10s; verify we don't trigger vendor throttle cascade. I'll run tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Elena Garcia: I'll add a dashboard panel and monitor top-10 refreshing subjects and include a query for the runbook.
Ravi Menon: Add a revocation listener task — if a token is revoked we must invalidate caches immediately. I'll coordinate with Security.
Maya Patel: Short-term guardrail: when vendor returns 429, serve cached token for up to 60s before failing requests to reduce reauth loops.
Kevin O'Connor: Also ask Legal to review SLA language for emergency throttle exceptions. I'll loop them in.
incidents-bot: Task created: "Auth-refresh hotfix & runbook" assigned to Tom Wu, Priya Rao. Due 24h.
Maya Patel: Action recap (brief): Tom push TTL+dedupe hotfix (24h) + revocation hook (48h); Priya runbook + tests (48h); Elena dashboards (7d); Ravi vendor + legal (48-72h); EngRuntime/Product evaluate signed-token option & circuit breakers (8w).
Tom Wu: ACK, starting the canary deploy and will post results.
Priya Rao: ACK, will update thread with test results and alert IDs.
Maya Patel: Thanks. We'll do a 20-min sync after canary completes. Drop blockers here. :eyes:
